item.title: Caldwell Wrestlers Finish 3-2 at Wildcat Duals
item.description: Caldwell’s guys won their first three matches Saturday in the Wildcat Duals at Marion, Illinois, before bowing in their final two matches. Caldwell defeated Johnston City, Illinois 54-29, routed Goreville, Illinois 72-3 and beat Fort Campbell 53-23.
